clue.text: King's left to support Northern town

indicators.note: the king has left, so his letter departs from the longer word

parts.note: to back up is to support or endorse someone
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch is said to have stayed behind to prop up some town in the North.
explanation.walkthrough: 'King's left' reads as 'the King has left': K leaves BACKUP. BACUP is a small mill town in Lancashire, in the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacup is a former cotton town in the Rossendale valley of Lancashire, northern England.

clue.text: Plant, say, for a change in 1 ac

indicators.note: one word is put in place of the other
the earlier answer is altered by the swap

parts.note: the answer to 1 across, the Lancashire town
taken as written
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: A plant, for instance, is suggested as an alteration in the clue across.
explanation.walkthrough: In BACUP put UTTER ('say') 'for' A: the 'change in' 1 across.
explanation.definitionFit: The buttercup is a common yellow-flowered meadow plant of the genus Ranunculus.

clue.text: Sort of cups in which tea's passed — around

indicators.note: the tea word is passed round the small word, enclosing it

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
taken as written

explanation.surface: A kind of cups through which tea is handed round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passed around' tells you the tea word circles the little word; 'cups' in the surface is drinkware, and the definition is the porcelain kind.
explanation.definitionFit: China is fine porcelain, the material of the best teacups.

clue.text: Musical work fitted to no pair — another one must join in

indicators.note: the extra letter enters the middle of the rearranged letters
the letters are fitted together in a new arrangement

parts.note: I, the Roman numeral, is one more

explanation.surface: A composition is set for a single player, so a second must take part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fitted' rearranges TO NO PAIR; I ('another one') must 'join in'. The surface's 'no pair' plays on a trio needing three.
explanation.definitionFit: A piano trio is a chamber piece for piano, violin and cello.

clue.text: Monotonous notes about a private conversation

indicators.note: the repeated notes go around the small word a, enclosing it

parts.note: the sol-fa note te sung over and over, four times, is monotonous

explanation.surface: Dull droning music accompanies a quiet chat between two people.
explanation.walkthrough: TE is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale; 'Monotonous' means the same note repeated, here four times, wrapped 'about' A.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase, literally head-to-head, used in English for an intimate talk between two people.

clue.text: Dense vegetation's just what's needed around front of house

indicators.note: the longer word goes round the single letter

parts.note: 'that's the ticket' means just the thing required

indicators.note: the leading letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: Thick undergrowth is the very thing to surround the front of a home.
explanation.walkthrough: TICKET goes 'around' H, the 'front of house'.
explanation.definitionFit: A thicket is a close growth of shrubs and small trees.

clue.text: It provides beat to rumba wildly

indicators.note: the letters are thrown about without order, as in a wild dance

explanation.surface: Something gives the rhythm to a frenzied Latin dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wildly' rearranges TO RUMBA.
explanation.definitionFit: A tambour is a drum, an instrument that keeps the rhythm.

clue.text: By the side of a lake, close to midnight

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake
on can mean beside or adjoining, as a town on a river
the middle letter of night is G

explanation.surface: Someone is beside a lake at almost twelve o'clock at night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close to midnight' looks like a time but splits into ON (beside) and G, the middle of 'night'.
explanation.definitionFit: Along means beside or alongside, as trees along a road.

clue.text: Unusually effective healer makes allowance for sporting injuries

parts.note: extra can mean exceptionally, beyond the usual
time is proverbially the great healer

explanation.surface: A remarkably skilled doctor provides for athletes hurt during play.
explanation.walkthrough: In football the referee adds extra minutes for stoppages, notably for treating hurt players.
explanation.definitionFit: Added minutes at the end of a game make up for time lost to stoppages for treating players.

clue.text: Makes topping pants

indicators.note: topping means removing the top, here the first letter

parts.note: to pant for something is to yearn for it

explanation.surface: Someone produces excellent underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topping pants' reads as superb trousers, but 'topping' means beheading YEARNS.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn money is to make it, as one makes a living.

clue.text: Modify one's opinions about island's divisive system

indicators.note: the outer word goes round the island's name, holding it

parts.note: to trim is to adjust one's views to suit the times, as a political trimmer does
Bali is an Indonesian island; the possessive adds an S

explanation.surface: Someone changes their views on a matter concerning an island's way of splitting people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Modify one's opinions' is a single definition of a verb: a political trimmer shifts views to suit the times. The island's name sits 'about'-wise between its I and M.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribalism, loyalty to one's own group above all, is a doctrine that separates people into hostile factions.

clue.text: Outrageous monarch appears in fur

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means outrageous or excessive
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword monarch

explanation.surface: A scandalous king or queen turns up dressed in furs.
explanation.walkthrough: OTT is British slang for 'over the top'; ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Otter is the pelt of the aquatic mammal, a prized dense brown fur.

clue.text: She can inspire some venerators

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the following word are used, a run from inside it

explanation.surface: A woman might move a few of the devout worshippers to great things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' takes a run of letters from inside 'venerators'. ERATO was the Muse of lyric and love poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is one of the nine Muses of Greek myth, the goddesses who gave poets inspiration.

clue.text: Plant drug on small group of people

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: a knot is a small cluster of people huddled together
grass is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Narcotics are pinned on a little gathering of folk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like the verb to plant evidence, chiming with 'drug', but it is the definition: a common weed.
explanation.definitionFit: Knotgrass is a low weedy herb of the dock family, common on waste ground.

clue.text: Entertainment provided by nude in outrageous act

indicators.note: the word for naked is placed within the jumbled letters
wild and unruly, so the letters of act are thrown into disorder

parts.note: nude means bare, unclothed

explanation.surface: A club show features a scandalous naked performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outrageous' turns ACT into CAT, and BARE goes 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabaret is a nightclub floor show of song, dance and comedy.

clue.text: Direct a star in dance

parts.note: to boss is to direct or order about
a nova is a star that suddenly flares

explanation.surface: Someone orders a celebrity about during a dance routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' suggests a celebrity but is the astronomical sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Bossa nova is a Brazilian music and dance style blending samba and jazz.

clue.text: Play at home with one leading Italian scorer

parts.note: Ross is Terence Rattigan's 1960 play about T. E. Lawrence
in means at home, not out
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A drama is staged at a house with the top Italian footballer in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scorer' suggests a goal-scoring striker, but it means one who writes musical scores.
explanation.definitionFit: Rossini, composer of The Barber of Seville, was a pre-eminent Italian writer of opera.

clue.text: Fielder in traditional cricket side

parts.note: square means old-fashioned or conventional
the leg side is one half of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A player stands on the field in an old-fashioned cricket team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'side' suggests a team, but the leg side is the half of a cricket field behind the batsman's legs. Square leg is a fielding position level with the batsman on that side.
explanation.definitionFit: Square leg is both a cricket fielding position and the player stationed there.

clue.text: One may get inert cops moving

definitions.text: One may get inert cops moving

indicators.note: the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: A senior officer may stir idle police into action.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is definition and wordplay: 'moving' rearranges INERT COPS.
explanation.definitionFit: A police officer of this rank supervises constables and sergeants and chivvies them along.

clue.text: Following offensive, cancelled leave

indicators.note: the word for cancelled comes after the word for offensive

parts.note: a push is a military offensive or advance
an event called off is cancelled

explanation.surface: After a military assault, someone's leave is called off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offensive' reads as an adjective but is the noun, a military push; 'leave' is the verb, not time off.
explanation.definitionFit: To push off is informal for to go away or depart.

clue.text: Easy one to spot in South Africa, this flower

parts.note: free and easy are near-synonyms, unrestricted and relaxed

indicators.note: the numeral is to be spotted inside the country's letters

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A bloom that is simple to find in South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to spot in' means the numeral is to be found inside the country. Freesias are in fact native to southern Africa, so the surface is true.
explanation.definitionFit: Freesia is a fragrant flowering plant grown from corms.

clue.text: They have very little money in a purse, perhaps

definitions.text: They have very little money in a purse, perhaps

indicators.note: the coin's letter is put inside the rearranged letters
signals that the letters of a purse may be arranged some other way

parts.note: p, a penny, is a very small sum of money

explanation.surface: The poor keep only small change in their wallets.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: P (a penny) goes 'in' A PURSE rearranged, signalled by 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: The destitute, by definition, have hardly any cash to carry.

clue.text: Got from one river to another — turned up a third.

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river

indicators.note: in a down answer, turned up means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge

explanation.surface: A traveller went from one river to a second, then arrived at a third.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'from PO TO CAM', with CAM 'turned up'. The Potomac flows past Washington DC.
explanation.definitionFit: The Potomac is a river of the eastern United States, a further waterway after the other two named.

clue.text: Strike with jet, a top-class fighter

parts.note: jet is a deep glossy black
to belt is to hit hard

explanation.surface: Someone hits out with a jet of water, a skilled combatant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jet' suggests a spray or plane, but it is the black gemstone, giving the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A black belt is the highest grade in judo and karate, held by an expert martial artist.

clue.text: Key is in vehicle that's overturned

indicators.note: the whole assembly is flipped, reading upwards in this down answer
the small word goes inside the vehicle

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
taken as written

explanation.surface: An important person sits in a car that has flipped over.
explanation.walkthrough: IS goes 'in' CAB, making CISAB, and 'that's overturned' reverses it all.
explanation.definitionFit: Basic means fundamental, as a key principle is.

clue.text: Understand why, as it's declared a republic

indicators.note: declared means spoken out, so the words are to be heard

parts.note: ken means understand and why is the question word; said together they make the sound

explanation.surface: Grasp the reason a nation proclaimed itself a republic.
explanation.walkthrough: Ken is Scots for know. The surface recalls Kenya becoming a republic in 1964.
explanation.definitionFit: Kenya, in East Africa, has been a republic with a president since 1964.

clue.text: One dividing wine, one sharing cider

indicators.note: the numeral splits the wine's letters by sitting inside them

parts.note: rosé is pink wine
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A person splits the wine and another shares the cider.
explanation.walkthrough: Cider with Rosie is Laurie Lee's memoir of a Cotswold childhood, so Rosie is the one with whom cider is shared.
explanation.definitionFit: In the title of the Laurie Lee book, the cider is drunk with a girl of this name.

clue.text: Master and servants

explanation.surface: The head of the house and his employees.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff is the rod of authority a master carries, and also the whole body of employees or household domestics.

clue.text: Type of blade used in rowing club

definitions.text: Type of blade used in rowing

explanation.surface: A particular oar shape is used by a boat club.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing oar with a curved, scooped blade bears this name, and an old wooden golf club roughly equal to a three-wood was called the same.

clue.text: Last music arranged for concurrent programmes

indicators.note: the letters are set out in a new order, as music is arranged

explanation.surface: The final piece of music is scored for broadcasts going out together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' rearranges LAST MUSIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A simulcast is a programme broadcast at the same time on radio and television, or on several channels.

clue.text: Coach and horse in near-accident

indicators.note: the horse's name is placed inside the shortened word
only nearly the whole word is used, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: a chance is an accident, something unplanned
an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: A carriage and its horse are involved in a narrow escape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'near-accident' is a near miss on the surface, but it means 'nearly CHANCE', CHANC, with ARAB 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A charabanc is an old open motor coach used for outings.

clue.text: Choose to attack

explanation.surface: Someone opts to launch an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: One may opt for something by deciding on it, and also set upon someone by rushing at them; the phrasal verb covers both.
